long_biography.plain_text:
Adrian Lee's approach to property finance starts with how a development works on the ground. At Jade Partners, he and his fellow partners draw on their experience as developers to assess projects before structuring investments. The firm's early trust financed existing residential projects, helping developers release capital for new opportunities.

Lee studied finance at the University of Strathclyde in Glasgow. As a former chief executive and chief operating officer of Raimon Land, he brought experience of Thai residential development to investment management. His responsibilities at Jade include business development, sales and marketing.
